children.name: Text_
children.characters:
Welcome to Paw World! 
Take your dogs out for walks, meet up with friends and join dog clubs. Stop by the kennel to welcome new furry friends or head to the dog park to train for sports trials at the competition center.

children.name: Text_Description
children.characters: This toy is great for strengthening a dog’s jaw and helping it relieve stress.

children.name: Text_
children.characters: Use the mic to teach your dogs cool tricks or call them over, dive into your inventory to glam them up with fun accessories, and use the camera to capture their cutest moments!

children.name: Text_
children.characters: Keep an eye on Energy to keep your dog active, build Endurance, Mobility, and Speed for performance in agility and disc competitions, and boost Focus for success in obedience and style trials!

children.name: Text_
children.characters: Take care of your dogs’ basic needs – provide food and water regularly to keep their belly full, maintain their hygiene to keep them clean, and ensure they stay active by playing or going for a walk.

children.name: Text_
children.characters: Use the navigation bar to go to the Shop for dog breeds and accessoires, explore the Map for walks and competitions, track your progress in Profile, and adjust preferences in Settings.
